thread:
Mira: quick sync — rolling partition swap for orders table planned tonight 01:00 PST. Goal: swap old partition to new range w/ zero downtime writes. Need deploybot holds for async index build + replica-lag gating. Canaries in us-west-2 only for first 4 shards. @oncall please ack?
Alex: ack, sounds good. we'll pin api and ingestion to v2.3.1 for the window. Add a feature flag to freeze new writes to legacy partition during swap :thumbsup:
Sam: +1. Suggest adding a preflight that verifies replica_lag <= 10s across replicas and that bgwriter stats are healthy. If lag > 45s -> abort/rollback.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled 'partition-swap-apply' job for 1771223344 (2025-03-12T01:00:00Z). Canaries: us-west-2-a -> 4 shards. Holdpoints: preflight, canary-verify, final-cutover.
Mira: preflight checks we'll run: 
```
-- quick check
SELECT max(replica_lag_seconds) FROM monitoring.replica_stats WHERE region IN ('us-west-2','us-east-1');
SELECT count(*) FROM orders_new_partition WHERE id IS NULL LIMIT 1;
```
If results are clean proceed to canary.
Ryan: note — index build on orders_new_idx is CONCURRENTLY and can run while writes active. But it can take >20m on hot shards. Plan: kick off concurrent index during canary and gate final swap on index_ready flag.
Alex: I'll draft release note: 'Partition swap: rolling, canaries, pinned services v2.3.1, abort on replica lag or index timeout'. Put runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/ops/partition-swap
Sam: runbook step note — if index build > 30m, cut to 'partial-swap' mode: swap only non-hot shards and schedule remaining later. Don't attempt global revert unless catastrophic.
oncall-bot: watchdog: replica-lag threshold set -> 45s. Trigger actions: post in #incidents, pause deploybot, alert @oncall.
Mira: adding manual holdpoint between canary-verify and final-cutover. @alex please pin release tag and mark rollback steps in runbook. I'll be oncall for the window.
Alex: pinned tag v2.3.1-release-20250312. Runbook updated with rollback steps and rollback SQL snippet.
Sam: rollback snippet posted in runbook: 
```
BEGIN;
-- re-point writes
UPDATE routing SET target = 'orders_old' WHERE tenant_id = ANY(ARRAY[...]);
-- revert partition config
ALTER TABLE orders ATTACH PARTITION orders_old FOR VALUES FROM (...);
COMMIT;
```
Ryan: will stream pg_stat_activity + replication metrics to #eng-releases during canary. I'll post a short summary at +5m and +15m.
Mira: perfect. if anyone sees replica_lag > 45s during canary ping me immediately. Otherwise we proceed at 01:00 PST. :rocket:
Alex: ACK
Sam: ACK
deploybot: note: remember to run small dry-run on staging first (scheduled 1771210000), logs in deploybot UI.
Mira: thanks — closing planning thread, will open a follow-up checklist in #release-ops with explicit holdpoint times.
